title: Equipment Technician
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As a Test Equipment Technician, you are responsible for the installation and maintenance of manufacturing equipment. Sustain and improve key performance indices of the equipment through continuous improvement activities

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for Test equipment transfer, setup and buyoff, and support for manufacturing ramp up

  • Responsible for sustain equipment uptime, with hand on trouble shooting on the equipment

  • Perform and complete the scheduled PM as per plan

  • Perform equipment setup, buyoff, and conversion

  • Work on spare part/tools/meters management

  • Performs electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electro-mechanical equipment used in the manufacturing process

  • Dismantles, adjusts, repairs and assembles equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches or drawings

  • Uses test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts.

  • Rebuilds manufacturing equipment as required

  • May perform equipment modifications as directed by engineers.

Requirements:-

  • Diploma in mechanical engineering & Electronic/Electrical Engineering

  • Highly motivated individuals with more than1 year working experience are encouraged to apply

  • Good understanding of Semiconductor Testing equipment processes. In-depth knowledge & hands on experience will be a plus point.

  • A good teammate equipped with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Leveraging AI tools to: Retrieve technical information and Support troubleshooting

     

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
